dct_description_sm: Washington, D.C., published Nov. 1916, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Relief shown by rock drawings, shading, spot heights; depths by soundings.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Includes Conversion Table, Foreign and English Terms, buoy legend, Lights information.
Shows shoals, waterways, ports, islands, railways.

Maps: 1. West Coast, Simeulu Island, Natural Scale 1:292,289 [Inset chart: Simeulu - East Coast, Labuan Bajau] / From a Netherland Government survey in 1911 and 1912 -- 2. Pulo Weh, Rubia Island Anchorage, Natural Scale 1:15,380 / From a Netherland Government survey in 1893 -- 3. Pulo Weh, Sabang Bay, Natural Scale 1:15,228 / From a Netherland Government chart of 1912 with additions to 1928.
